When the live re-derivation runs (scripts/derive_scoped_smoke.py), it replaces these values with measured tpca and drops placeholder_until_live_rederivation. The dual-pass CI test asserts methodology (scoped < unscoped via mock backend) UNCONDITIONALLY; it asserts tolerance bounds against expected_*_tpca only when placeholder_until_live_rederivation is false.
